author: Andrew Fisher
purpose: Illustrative Showcase landmark placement only; no operational pins or circuit geometry edits.
method: Reuses existing main-plan sheet-to-z18 transform and Showcase scale/rotation; origin recovered from explicit shared OSM node10168056545 on packed pit way179722656. Latitude−27.99 is a local ground-scale approximation. No image matching, photo GPS estimate or optimisation performed.
limits: Original gc3d_registration.json translation is unavailable; this is a validated approximate recovery, not the lost original matrix.
Twelve packed pit points reproduce saved OSM points within0.676m; this does not remove the schematic circuit registration error (recorded median1.378m, p95 5.456m, max17.507m).
Master aerial registration reports main-plan held-out maximum1.611m; not suitable for set-out.
Map endpoints provide along-track anchor and crossing direction, not surveyed bridge dimensions. Deck clearance and actual barrier ends must use current scene boundaries.
Coordinates are already in current scene points. Multiplying/dividing by a6m fallback would misplace them; the active scale is5.937552372855356m per scene point.
